title: Consider the system-provided color picker

statement.en: Consider the system-provided color picker for a familiar, consistent experience.
statement.ja: familiarでconsistentなexperienceのためにsystem-provided color pickerを検討する。

conditions: The built-in picker lets people save colors for access from any app.
It can provide familiarity across iOS, iPadOS, and macOS.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Color wells experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるColor wellsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

portable_interpretation: Preserve the user-centered intent after replacing Apple-specific platforms, components, and input conventions.

title: Avoid color wells in tvOS and watchOS

statement.en: Avoid using color wells in tvOS or watchOS.
statement.ja: tvOSまたはwatchOSでcolor wellを使うことを避ける。

conditions: Apple HIG records color wells as unsupported on these platforms.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Color wells experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
